name: services/mailclient/user
description: Get a list of user's messages. You can optionally filter the list by message status.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector must contain subset of primary fields, which are described in the returns section of message method.

arguments.name: status
arguments.description: List of status values (draft, pending, sent, error). All messages with different status will be filtered out.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A list od dictionaries describing messages. Each dictionary contains keys listed in the fields argument.
